text: Good evening. We affirm the resolution that the United States federal government should substantially increase its investment in public transit.
Our first contention is congestion. Um, the Texas Transportation Institute finds that drivers lost fifty four hours a year to traffic in 2023.
That's time away from families, that's wasted fuel, and it falls hardest on people who can't afford to live near where they work.
Our second contention is emissions. Transportation is the largest source of greenhouse gas emissions in the United States at roughly twenty eight percent.
Transit moves more people per unit of fuel, so every rider we shift off the road is a direct reduction.
For these reasons we strongly urge an affirmative ballot. Thank you.
